Fee-on-transfer deposit overcredit: the deposit path pulls tokens with transferFrom and credits the NOMINAL amount parameter as shares / balance, without measuring how much actually arrived (balanceOf before vs after). A fee-on-transfer, rebasing-down or otherwise short-delivering token is credited at face value, and the credited position redeems against the full pool - the shortfall is taken from the other depositors. Observed: 'deposit' pulls 'amount' with transferFrom and credits it at face value (_mint credit to recipient) with no balanceOf delta measurement anywhere in the function. Gate

Fee-on-transfer deposit overcredit: the deposit path pulls tokens with transferFrom and credits the NOMINAL amount parameter as shares / balance, without measuring how much actually arrived (balanceOf before vs after). A fee-on-transfer, rebasing-down or otherwise short-delivering token is credited at face value, and the credited position redeems against the full pool - the shortfall is taken from the other depositors. Observed: 'enter' pulls '_quickAmount' with transferFrom and credits it at face value (_mint credit to msg.sender) with no balanceOf delta measurement anywhere in the function.

Ungated residual-balance sweep: a public / external function sends the contract's entire native balance (address(this).balance) or its entire token balance (token.balanceOf(address(this))) to msg.sender or a caller-supplied recipient, with no caller-identity gate and no per-user ledger bounding the payout - the Dex223 SwapRouter refundETH / unwrapWETH9 shape. A payout sized by the caller's own recorded balance or by an amount parameter is the protected shape.
